name: Adaptive Quality
aliases: Frame Rate Maintenance via Quality Adjustment
definition: A quality reduction mechanism that relies on measuring the current rendering time and adjusting quality (number of casted rays, sampling distances, etc.) for the next rendering request to achieve a requested frame rate. It works well for CPUs because computation time is predictable.
summary: Adaptive Quality dynamically adjusts rendering parameters to maintain a target frame rate, distinguishing itself by allocating computational budgets per frame rather than reducing viewport size or using spatial foveation.
